blocks.heading: Dividing in a ratio
lines: Add the parts, find one part, then multiply.
Divide 960 in 5 : 7: 12 parts, one part = 80, shares 400 and 560.

blocks.heading: Combining ratios
lines: Make the common term equal in both ratios.
a : b = 2 : 3 and b : c = 4 : 5. Scale to 8 : 12 and 12 : 15.

blocks.heading: Changing ratios and ages
lines: Write the quantities as ratio × x, then build an equation.
Ages: add or subtract the years from each person, not from the ratio.
Ratio 5 : 7, six years ago 2 : 3: 3(5x - 6) = 2(7x - 6), so x = 6.
If both sides save the same amount, equate (income - expense) for each.

blocks.heading: Variation and partnership
lines: Direct: the ratio stays fixed (cost ÷ length is constant).
Inverse: the product stays fixed (workers × days).
Partners share profit in the ratio of investment × time.
